costumes.name: Fairy Rabbit
costumes.description:
Flora costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: If you'd like to meet me, feel free to come to the garden.

Today, you remind me of a sunflower.
I wonder what flower you'll resemble tomorrow.

I often hear people say that my mind is like a flower garden.
Perhaps it's because I know so much about flowers, haha.

Flowers have the power to lift people's spirits.
Did you know that you have that power as well, Blossom?

I was wondering where that lovely floral scent was coming from.
Turns out it was you, Blossom.
In the future, I'd love to join you on the surface and grow beautiful flowers.

Will you be away for long?
If so, I'll wait in the garden.
Hehe, I'm fine playing with the flowers, so take your time.
It would be nice to create a garden here that suits you, Blossom.

This one is... a rose, and that one... a tulip.
There are many people here who resemble flowers. It's a lovely place.
Someday, a garden might bloom here, don't you think?

How do you do? Flora from Botanic Garden, at your service.
Would you like to visit my garden?
Now I can better tend to my garden.
You always know when I'm starting to wither.
Thank you for your concern.
Hehe, I should place this in the garden.
It feels like I'm always the one receiving gifts. Is there nothing you want, Blossom?
Next time, I'll prepare a gift for you.

I used to find joy in cultivating flowers on my own.
... But now, I find even greater joy in seeing them bloom alongside you.

Do you know what the lisianthus flower represents?
I'll give you a hint: it's what I feel for you, hehe.
... You're the first one I've ever liked more than flowers.

It would be nice if the flowers could come along too.
So they could see the sunlight.
Yes, Blossom?
Be careful not to step on the sprouts.
Shall we start purifying the air with the flowers?
I will protect both Blossom and the flowers.
... The flowers are crying.
Let's show them the power of flowers.
Keep an eye out for places where we can plant flowers.
Aren't there any seeds around?
Perhaps I should have brought some poisonous herbs...
It's time for the flowers to bloom.
Shall we let the seeds sprout?
This is the most beautiful flower in the world.
Let's use it for the potted plants.
The flowers are coming back to life.
They are being purified.
Eek!
Ugh...!
Eeep!
... I need to go water the garden.
Victory is blooming before our very eyes.

favorite.name: Planter We Made Together
favorite.description:
A handcrafted planter, carefully shaped and lovingly painted.
It carries the precious memories and heartfelt feelings shared with someone special, so the flowers are sure to bloom beautifully for a long time to come.
